service.description: Stores, each part once (a part whose space or note is there already is left as it is): - BOSSKB "Team handbook": everyone reads, john.doe administers, joe.developer edits, bob.developer reads only. Pages Home, Onboarding with Onboarding/First week, Policies with Travel (two versions), Expenses and Security (restricted: john.doe and bob.developer read it, joe.developer may not), Office with Office/Wi-Fi and printers, and Release process (three versions by joe.developer and john.doe with their notes, 02 published, 03 waiting on john.doe's review, asked by joe.developer; no tray notification, so the M2 demo's one approval stays the only one), with relative, [[path]] and wiki: links between them, one to a page not made yet, a comment by joe.developer and a file on Office; - BOSSLEAD "Leadership": members only (john.doe administers, bob.developer reads), the page Hiring plan; - BOSSENG "Engineering notes": a space in a git repository in the database (WIKI_BOSSENG), two pages, each save a commit; - john.doe's notes (NOTES_EX_JOHN_DOE): Groceries and Cabin Wi-Fi pinned and tagged Home, Ideas for the newsletter and Call with Acme tagged Work; joe.developer's note Conference talk draft. A part that fails is logged by name and the others are still loaded.
One part of load#KnowledgeDemo: team (the Team handbook), leadership, engineering (the git space), johnNotes or joeNotes.
